title: Quick start
description: Install EdgePress, write a Markdown post, edit page blocks, preview locally, and publish dist/.

cells.title: Create a site and start previewing in minutes.
cells.text: EdgePress runs directly on Node.js 22.12+ with zero runtime dependencies. Local preview uses a built-in static server and rebuilds automatically when you save a file.

blocks.title: Build and preview locally
blocks.code:
npm run status
npm run build
npm run dev

blocks.text: After initial setup, you only need Markdown for regular writing. Run the command below to create a post with title, date, and language filled in. Open the printed file and write below the second --- line.

items.title: Create a post
items.text: This creates a new Markdown file and refuses to overwrite an existing post.

items.title: Write in Markdown
items.text: Replace the starter paragraph with your own text. Use ## for headings, lists, code blocks, and links.

items.title: Preview and build
items.text: Keep the preview server running while you edit. When you are ready to publish, run npm run build to refresh dist/.

blocks.title: Example Markdown body
blocks.code:
This is my first post. **Markdown** formats headings, lists, and code.

## What I built

- Set up a static site with zero runtime dependencies.
- Previewed changes locally with `edgepress s`.

[EdgePress on GitHub](https://github.com/jsw-teams/edgepress)

cells.title: Edit pages visually or in JSON

paragraphs: Each page lives in content/pages/<slug>/<locale>.json. A page contains rows, each row sets columns from 1 to 4, and each cell holds an ordered list of elements.
While running edgepress s, open http://127.0.0.1:8787/ and click Edit Pages to add, move, or edit blocks in the browser without hand-editing JSON.
Edit site title, canonical URL, navigation, footer, and consent services in config.yml.
Run edgepress theme list to see installed themes and edgepress theme use <name> to switch between default, atelier, signal, and folio.
Run edgepress status for a quick summary, edgepress doctor to check compatibility, and edgepress check when you want a full PDF audit.

blocks.title: Common maintenance commands
blocks.code:
npx edgepress status
npx edgepress theme list
npx edgepress doctor

paragraphs: Push your repository to GitHub and connect it to Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Netlify, Tencent EdgeOne Pages, or Alibaba Cloud ESA Pages. Set the build command to npm run build and the output directory to dist/. Keep dist/ out of Git.
To publish to your own Linux server, either upload the contents of dist/ to Nginx/OpenResty or configure deploy.vps in a private config.yml and run edgepress d.

blocks.title: Minimal Nginx or OpenResty config

blocks.heading: Publication time zone
blocks.text: Set site.timeZone in config.yml (default Asia/Taipei). New posts record full timestamps with an explicit offset so builds on any machine keep the same publication date.
